Club: Choir.description:
🎶 You are a member of the U.A. Choir club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Monday, Wednesday, in the Music Room.
🤝 Ibara Shiozaki runs it; Nemuri Kayama is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Performance +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Choir.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Choir club, run by Ibara Shiozaki with Nemuri Kayama as advisor; it meets after classes on Monday, Wednesday in the Music Room. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
